digest.component_or_area: ticket creation and editing with plan review gate integration
propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be emitted at save time (create or edit) stating the actual length, the cap, and that claim review will refuse admission until shortened.
The save-time warning must be computed and returned without blocking or altering the ticket write, and must degrade silently to None on any unexpected error.

The warning must be emitted through three surfaces: CLI (stderr as 'Warning: ...'), library (rebar logger, with edit_ticket returning str|None and create_ticket(return_alias=True) carrying description_warning in dict), and MCP (optional description_warning field on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut).

The description_cap_warning() function must reuse the exact same _plan_review_gate_applies() probe and config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) that the plan-review admission guard uses, ensuring a single source of truth and that the warning cannot promise a block the gate would not make.
No warning must be emitted when the gate is disabled, when the ticket type is exempt, or when the description is within the configured cap.

The config key verify.max_ticket_description_chars must be shared by three readers: the plan-review guard (det_floor.py), the completion precheck (gate_ops.py), and the new save-time warning (gates.py).
